name: iw8
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2019 (IW8)
note: Addresses from the decrypted ModernWarfare.exe (PE timestamp 1776100781, the install's 1.69.0.26668155), flattened (file offset == RVA). Primitives read by disassembly (ParseFastFile 0x36b1600, ReadXFile 0x36a6d60, ResolveStreamPosition 0x2d96240). Load_Stream's flag is inverted against the other IW titles: 1 reads nothing, 0 reads at the stream position (stream.flag_inverted).
rva_note: file_read = DB_ReadXFile(dst, n). Load_Stream(flag, dst, n): flag 1 returns at once; block 4 memsets, any other block reads; then the position advances. load_string (char **p): the text one byte at a time through file_read (stream.byte_strings); load_string_ptr the same then interned (AllocateUniqueString 0x3af2b70), *p = its index. push/pop keep a stack at 0x133dd390 (16 bytes a level), pop rewinds block 1 and aligns block 2 to 32. insert_ptr: push(5), align 8, 8 bytes, pop. alloc: align (0x2d88a10, mask 7) and the position (the asset list's only; readers inline it). resolve: block = (v >> 32) & 0xf, offset = (u32)v - 1 (+ a block's delta when bit 36 is set), through the asset offset lists (0x2d88670); resolve_deref the same, dereferenced. advance: the aligner every alloc and reader calls (0x2d88a10(mask)): the stream position aligned in its block, moved through the block's asset offset list (0xbaa9a20, empty here) when there is one.

asset_dispatch.note: ParseFastFile 0x36b1600: varXAsset (0xbacc070) = &list[i]; Load_XAsset(1) (no read: the entry is in the array); it sets varXAssetHeader (0xbacc050) and calls the type switch 0x2dc5f90 (a cmp chain) which calls each Load_<T>Ptr with the same flag

stream.markers_note: a Ptr loader (0x2e13230) streams the asset for -1, -2 and -3; -1 also opens an asset offset frame (0x2d898c0/0x2d895f0), -3 reserves a slot (insert_ptr); anything else is a back reference (resolve_deref)
stream.advance_wrappers_note: 279 per-type allocs (sub rsp; mov ecx, mask; call advance 0x2d88a10; mov rax, [stream_pos]; ret, e.g. 0x2dd8e60): the emulator runs them, the transcriber reads them as allocs
stream.growing_note: reads land in 1 (asset headers and temp data: pop 0x36b1330 rewinds it), 5 (520 MB of the 506 recorded zones) and 7 (8 reads); 4 memsets
stream.pointer_ifs_note: the Ptr loaders (0x2e42720) are transcribed as IF chains on their own field, one arm per marker: a taken arm is the pointer followed, and -3 reserves its insert_ptr slot in block 5 (0x36b1200: align 8, 8 bytes)
stream.backref_asset_note: resolve 0x2d96240: with bit 36 set the offset adds 0x2d88c10(block), the block cursor 0x2d88fc0 recorded when the zone-level asset began (frame 0 at 0xbaa9a60)

zone_load.note: ParseFastFile 0x36b1600: file_read of the 0x20-byte XAssetList {u32 stringCount, strings, u32 assetCount, assets} into the caller's (var 0xbacc088); push(5), varScriptStringList (0xbacc568) = list, Load_ScriptStringList(1) 0x2ddb760 (alloc, the slots, then each slot by 0x2ddc1b0: 0 none, -2/-1 the text inline, else a back reference), pop; push(5), the array allocated (0x2dc07b0) and read (count x 16), the asset loop, pop
zone_load.init_alignment_note: InitAssetAlignmentInternal: empties the eight blocks' asset offset lists (0xbaa9a20, null in the exe) and zeroes the frame depth 0xbaa9ae8 the -1 assets push

install_note: CASC storage: decompress pulls each .ff and its .fp update patch into install_dir; GrayWolf applies the .fp beside the .ff (Games/IW8/Container.cpp). The working set: the 57 base zones, 125 localized, 25 transient (_tr) zones per name family (of 25 260)

asset_link.note: LinkGenericXAsset 0x36a8350(type, &header): the Ptr loaders store its result in the slot; XAssetHeaderSizes 0x7411a00 (u32 per type)
